_comment: Single MSVC Release policy for dependencies rebuilt by build_scripts. The root CMake graph uses cmake/QimgvMsvcPolicy.cmake. /GS, /DYNAMICBASE, /HIGHENTROPYVA and /NXCOMPAT are toolchain defaults and are intentionally absent; /O2 already implies /Ob2 /Oi /Ot. The 'isa' map selects the instruction set: 'arch' is placed before 'compile', and 'deps_suffix' is appended to every install, build and output folder name. The suffixes must match QIMGV_DEPS_SUFFIX in cmake/QimgvMsvcPolicy.cmake.
